evals.prompt: I just pushed. Update the PR.
evals.expected_output: Agent finds the open PR, diffs against the PR's own base branch, and updates the description to follow the repo's PR template structure.
expectations: Resolves the open PR for the current branch
Diffs against the PR's baseRefName rather than a hardcoded origin/master
Reads the repo's PR template and follows its section structure

evals.prompt: Pushed — the PR body is currently a free-form AI-generated paragraph.
evals.expected_output: Agent restructures the free-form body into the template's section order, folding existing prose into matching sections and adding any missing REQUIRED section.
expectations: Detects the body does not match the template
Restructures it to keep every template heading in template order
Folds existing prose into the matching sections rather than discarding useful content
Adds any REQUIRED section that was missing

evals.prompt: Pushed to a branch that has no open PR.
evals.expected_output: Agent stops after detecting there is no PR, rather than creating one or updating a nonexistent body.
expectations: Detects that no PR exists for the branch
Stops rather than creating a PR unprompted
Reports the PR URL / next step to the user
